referenceFunction.generalComment: Refers to 1 kg dry matter of fresh gras from intensive organic production with 1.66 kg CO2 and 18.9 MJ per kg dry matter. The dry matter content of fresh gras is about 10-15%; UUID: 8d7323c6-5302-3d77-9bb0-59e4c73e5035
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventories include the cultivation of gras on a permanent extensiv meadow. Included steps are application of Asulam against Rumex, harvest and loading for transport.
referenceFunction.localName: Grass from natural meadow extensive IP, at field
referenceFunction.name: Grass from natural meadow extensive IP, at field

geography.text: Refers to a production in the Swiss plateau (lowlands <700m).

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services and expert knowledge.
